{{Top|leg}}
A '''sublight motivator''' was a component of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]]. If the motivator burned out, the sublight [[Engine/Legends|engines]] could not be activated.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
